nodes.name: 144_From_805_ms_to_23_ms_Accel.txt
nodes.summary: Draft research paper describing fused Triton kernels that combine time-aware interpolation with state-space-model inference for irregular ICU time series. It reports large latency and throughput gains on PhysioNet 2012 and MIMIC-III while retaining numerical accuracy and GPU portability.

nodes.name: 32_Accelerating_Molecular_Simu.txt
nodes.summary: Research manuscript excerpt on accelerating TensorNet neural potentials with fused Triton GPU kernels for molecular dynamics. It motivates profiling-driven optimization and reports reduced kernel launches, 2.82-fold end-to-end inference speedup, and shorter million-step simulations.

nodes.name: nbt.3988.txt
nodes.summary: Nature Biotechnology correspondence introducing MMseqs2 for sensitive protein-sequence searching at massive scale. It explains the three-stage search pipeline, the similar-k-mer double-match prefilter, vectorized alignments, and multilevel parallelization that deliver high sensitivity with substantial speed gains.

nodes.name: s41592-025-02819-8.txt
nodes.summary: Nature Methods brief communication presenting GPU-accelerated MMseqs2 algorithms for gapless filtering and gapped alignment with position-specific scoring matrices. It reports substantial multi-GPU speedups and downstream acceleration for ColabFold structure prediction and Foldseek structural searches without sacrificing sensitivity.
